world_policy: Independent fresh calendar RNG worlds. DEMO is never used in model selection or scoring. November has no generated outcome.
variant_policy: BASE plus one named intervention per family. Same random demand stream for paired variants; no scenario label as feature.
calibrated_patterns: Approved aggregate Monash intermittent-demand references and M5/Favorita relative variation metadata. They do not identify a Bolivian price elasticity. No row-level external data is copied.
test_policy: Sealed new synthetic TEST, no model scoring or selection in generator. Structural validation only. Old 2.2 TEST never reused.

actual_pattern_parameters_used.monash: Aggregate occurrence probability, plus explicitly assumed turnover offsets
actual_pattern_parameters_used.m5: Probability of an observed weekly price change, used as synthetic reference frequency
actual_pattern_parameters_used.uci: Reviewed reference for order and cancellation semantics, no fitted coefficient in this generator
actual_pattern_parameters_used.favorita: Reviewed scope and missingness/calendar restrictions, no fitted coefficient in this generator
